t0.estimand_note: T0 and T1 probabilities estimate different quantities.
t0.predictor_scope: lead intake only; no inquiry, Spot, Availability, outcome, lead_score_internal or historical counters
t0.folds: Same frozen calendar boundaries applied to T0 score_time; expanding train before validation window.
t0.decision_rule: PROMOTE only if macro delta AP >= 0.01, paired lead-bootstrap AP CI95 lower > 0, macro AUC >= 0.55, and Brier does not worsen by >0.002; otherwise NEUTRAL_EVIDENCE_BACKED.

t2.model_family: regularized logistic regression for both variants
t2.baseline_scope: frozen intake + current inquiry payload + deterministic current-vs-intake refinement only
t2.trajectory_scope: add only the 33 registered strict-prior T2 trajectory features
t2.split_policy: T1 lead membership plus current T2 score_time boundary truncation exactly as SPLIT_CONTRACT.
